title: Adjacency scan answers
statement: Let $C$ be a family of finite acyclic Boolean circuits, let $	au$ be a task (size, gate type, or edge), and let $n,iv,tv$ be natural numbers and $w$ a bit string. Suppose the input formed by pairing the unary string of length $n$ with $w$ has target $tv$ (and, for an edge task, source $iv$), and $w$ is exactly the task word encoding $iv,tv$. Then the scan's answer—true for the task's default answer when $tv<n$, the corresponding gate-hit answer when $tv-n$ is a gate index, and false otherwise—is the indicator of whether that input belongs to the language for task $	au$ associated with $C$.
